messages:
mira: Hit a confusing onboarding bug today. Our Ruby sampleapp surfaces a plaintext 429 body and raises APIError; JS/Go samples throw a typed RateLimitError with `.code` and `.retry_after_ms`. New users are tripped up trying to catch exceptions consistently.

dan: Oof. Any repro steps?

mira: Yes — curl -> 429 returns body `Too Many Requests` (legacy) for one fixture server and `{\"error\":{\"message\":\"Too many requests\",\"code\":\"rate_limit\"}}` (envelope) for new server. Ruby path does not parse envelope into a subclass.

olga: We should do two things: standardize the server envelope and add an SDK normalizer so all languages raise the same typed subclasses. That avoids changing server behavior for old clients.

dan: Agreed. Proposed mapping (HTTP -> SDK): 401 -> AuthError, 403 -> PermissionError, 404 -> NotFoundError, 409 -> ConflictError, 429 -> RateLimitError (include retry_after_ms), 5xx -> ServerError. Also include `code` (snake_case) and `hint` fields in the envelope.

mira: UX note: `message` must be safe to surface to users; any debug info goes in `meta`. Example envelope we want: `{\"error\":{\"message\":\"Quota exceeded\",\"code\":\"rate_limit\",\"retry_after_ms\":1500,\"retryable\":true,\"hint\":\"Try smaller batches or backoff.\"}}`.

olga: For streaming APIs, SDKs should emit a terminal `on_error(err, partial)` where `err` is normalized and `partial` contains delivered tokens. That way apps can show partial output + explain failure.

dan: Implementation owners? I can take Ruby adapter + sampleapp test harness. Mira can add a tiny fixture server in sampleapps that flips between legacy/envelope responses for CI.

mira: Yep — I'll add the fixture and a CI job that runs Ruby/JS/Go samples against both response types and asserts parity of exception class and attributes. ETA: EOW.

olga: I'll update the SDK error mapping doc and add a short docs section "Error shapes & handling" with examples for catching by class and inspecting `error.code`. Also a migration note about `normalize_errors` opt-in flag for minor releases.

qa-bot: Created task INFR-1804: "SDK error normalization + parity e2e (Ruby/JS/Go)" assigned to dan,mira,olga. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFR-1804

dan: One compatibility caveat: do not change raised exception classes for legacy behavior in a patch release. Provide opt-in normalize flag in minor, flip in major. We'll document this in the changelog.

mira: Sounds good. I'll paste failing logs into the ticket and link to the sampleapp snippets.

olga: Thanks — will review PRs in SDK sync on Thursday. :white_check_mark:
